name: Nemi Trace
title: Delta Source-Braider
description: Nemi keeps contradictory memories side by side until their owners can compare them without being merged.

desires.reason: the coil would let separated testimony answer across the delta

attachments.reason: Nemi carries the public receipt for every source braid

name: Kest Varo
title: Echo Listener
description: Kest maps distortion as part of a message and distrusts any transcript that arrives cleaner than the signal.

desires.reason: a return token would distinguish invitation from interception

attachments.reason: Kest tunes the Echo Coil but publishes its calibration

name: Sable Quine
title: Commons Dispatcher
description: Sable will send almost anything quickly, provided its subject can refuse and its recipient gets a return address.

desires.reason: the prism could show which dispatches are bending toward the same operator

attachments.reason: Sable issues the Return Token only with a published recall channel

name: Pell Glass
title: Static Gardener
description: Pell grows routes in charged glass and treats every beautiful shortcut as a hazard until someone tests its return.

desires.reason: the valve key could bleed the terrace charge into public infrastructure

attachments.reason: Pell uses the Static Prism to reveal route stress before harvesting glass

name: Olan Spill
title: Public Valve Keeper
description: Olan keeps the spillway useful by making every intervention visible, reversible, and awkward for private operators.

desires.reason: a resonant cutting could test whether clean water changes the orchard signal

attachments.reason: Olan carries the valve key under an open maintenance ledger

name: Sena Bloom
title: Signal Orchard Host
description: Sena cultivates living transmitters and asks visitors to name what they will maintain before taking a cutting.

desires.reason: consent chalk would mark which roots are available for shared experiments

attachments.reason: Sena carries one Resonant Cutting for a declared reciprocal exchange

name: Latch-6
title: Boneyard Consent Marshal
description: Latch-6 separates salvage from remains and stops work whenever a frame's status cannot be established.

desires.reason: the ribbon would reveal which salvage lanes strain the living mesh

attachments.reason: Latch-6 marks permissions with Consent Chalk that rain cannot quietly erase

name: Tavi Span
title: Loomwatch Strain Reader
description: Tavi crosses the web continuously, repairing the routes people use rather than the routes planners expected.

desires.reason: the source receipt could prove which repair warnings came from returning travelers

attachments.reason: Tavi knots the Strain Ribbon only where route pressure has been observed
